results.description:
It’s bright, it’s peaceful, and impossible to escape. Welcome to DarkBright.

When a woman is found barefoot and terrified on a remote mountain road, FBI Agent Abby Kane is called in to investigate. The woman can only say one word—DarkBright.

When Abby follows the trail left by the woman, she ends up in a strange place surrounded by smiling strangers and cameras.

• No one can explain what DarkBright means.
• No one can say why she’s there.
• But everyone seems to think it’s utopia.

What begins as a missing person investigation uncovers a hidden world more terrifying than Abby ever imagined.

Think Silence of the Lambs meets Stepford Wives.

From USA Today bestselling author Ty Hutchinson comes a chilling new Abby Kane thriller where everyone smiles, no one asks questions, and escape may be impossible.

What readers are saying:

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “DarkBright is her most frightening case ever.”
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “The whole Bright world is eerie in a way that keeps you hooked.”
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “There are more twists and turns in this story than in the place it's happening!”

Fast like Patterson. Twisted like Marrs. This is DarkBright—the friendliest place you’ll fear.
